history.previous_guideline: When BERT predicts Environmental_exposures on ingestible, potable, or consumable water sources (e.g., safe drinking water, unsafe water, common-source water, tap water), override BERT and label as Nutrition when the context denotes fluid intake, hydration, or consumable water supply; preserve BERT's Environmental_exposures prediction only when the candidate span denotes non-potable environmental reservoirs, ambient water bodies, or passive exposure vectors (e.g., floodwater, wastewater runoff).
history.reason: Restricts DG-0036 Nutrition classification strictly to individual hydration/consumption behaviors and redirects municipal utility and drinking water quality indicators to Socioeconomic_factors.

guidebook.span_sentence: smartphones

triad.description: Generator over-rejected BERT's valid Non_physical_leisure_time_activities prediction on interactive screen devices to Non-LSF under generic hardware exclusions.

guidebook.guideline: When BERT predicts Non_physical_leisure_time_activities on digital media, screen time, or online platform terms (e.g., social media, screen time, internet use, smartphones), confirm BERT and preserve Non_physical_leisure_time_activities as voluntary leisure behavior; override BERT and label as O only when the span strictly denotes a non-behavioral research tool, recruitment channel, or generic communication hardware without personal recreational engagement.

history.previous_guideline: When BERT predicts Non_physical_leisure_time_activities on screen-based digital devices or electronic media modalities (e.g., smartphones, tablets, computers, screens), confirm BERT and preserve Non_physical_leisure_time_activities; do not override to O under generic hardware exclusions, as interactive screen devices operate as direct behavioral proxies for digital leisure and screen-time habits.
history.reason: Constrain overly broad digital media rule to explicitly exclude non-behavioral study settings, recruitment venues, and communication channels.

history.previous_guideline: When BERT predicts Non_physical_leisure_time_activities on screen-based digital devices, electronic media modalities, or digital platforms (e.g., smartphones, tablets, social media, online forums), confirm BERT and preserve Non_physical_leisure_time_activities only when candidate spans denote individual voluntary recreational use, entertainment, or screen-time habits; override BERT and label as O when the term functions as a study setting, participant recruitment venue, or non-behavioral communication channel.
history.reason: Restructure DG-0037 to lead with the negative override condition against generic communication and research contexts, clarifying boundaries to prevent false-positive confirmation on non-behavioral mentions.

history.previous_guideline: When BERT predicts Non_physical_leisure_time_activities on digital technology, electronic media modalities, or online platform terms (e.g., social media, internet use, smartphones, online forums), override BERT and label as O when the candidate span denotes a generic communication medium, research/survey tool, study recruitment venue, or non-behavioral reference; confirm BERT and preserve Non_physical_leisure_time_activities only when candidate spans explicitly reflect an individual's voluntary, recreational screen-time habit or leisure pursuit (e.g., recreational internet browsing, leisure social media use, video gaming).
history.reason: Prevent over-rejection of standard digital leisure and social media spans to Non-LSF by tightening the exclusion condition.

guidebook.span_sentence: Patients reported regular use of Cannabidiol and N-acetyl cysteine alongside standard therapy.

triad.description: Generator uncritically accepted BERT's incorrect Nutrition/Sleep predictions for exogenous bioactive chemical compounds and cannabinoids instead of classifying them as Substance_use.

guidebook.guideline: When BERT predicts Nutrition or Sleep on candidate spans representing exogenous bioactive substances, cannabinoids, or non-food pharmacological compounds (e.g., cannabidiol, melatonin, N-acetyl cysteine), override BERT and label as Substance_use; confirm BERT and preserve Nutrition only when candidate spans denote conventional foods, beverages, dietary macronutrients, or dietary regimens, and preserve Sleep only when candidate spans denote sleep behaviors, states, or circadian rhythms.

guidebook.span_sentence: The study evaluated alcohol intake patterns among college student drinkers across multiple campuses.

triad.description: Generator over-filtered a behavioral agentive compound span to O due to misinterpreting demographic/student modifiers as excluded demographic entities.

guidebook.guideline: When BERT predicts Socioeconomic_factors or Non-LSF on compound noun phrases containing an agentive behavioral consumer head modified by a demographic, educational, or population descriptor (e.g., college student drinkers, adolescent smokers, teenage vapers), override BERT and label as Substance_use, as agentive behavioral heads denote active consumption habits; label as O or Socioeconomic_factors only when the span designates a pure demographic or educational cohort lacking an active consumer head (e.g., college students, adolescent cohort, undergraduate population).
